cases.behavior: Field trimming/email normalization, root validation, aliases and nested models remain valid under a Pydantic 2 runtime.
Alias and field-name population, whitespace trimming, extra-field rejection and ORM attribute input remain unchanged.
Dictionary aliases, exclusion of absent values, nested serialization and JSON datetime output remain unchanged.
Object, JSON, nested payload and validation-error boundaries remain unchanged.
Native and pydantic.v1 imports coexist behind a dictionary boundary, preserving coercion and validation under installed Pydantic 2.
